warnings.message: Poetry: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for Poetry 2.5.1, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (requires-poetry in [tool.poetry], .tool-versions or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: Poetry: installer.only-binary applies when packages are installed; poetry lock may still build source distributions to read their dependencies
Poetry: installer.only-binary forbids building only packages from an index; Poetry still builds git, local directory and source archive dependencies
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor to find them in the lockfile

warnings.message: Poetry has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Poetry has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Dependabot: default-days: 7 in .github/dependabot.yml (line 8) waits 1 week for pip updates, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply replaces it with 3, so Dependabot waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "7d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again

warnings.message: poetry.toml matches the rule /poetry.toml in .gitignore (line 4), so git ignores it: what depcurfew apply writes there stays on this machine, and a fresh clone (CI included) does not get it
warnings.fix: Remove /poetry.toml from .gitignore, or add the file with git add -f poetry.toml, then commit it
